name: What types of deck lighting are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of deck lighting are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deck lighting options include post cap lights, recessed lights for stairs and decking, string lights, and accent lighting. Each type offers different aesthetic and functional benefits. For example, recessed lights provide subtle illumination and enhance safety on stairs, while post cap lights offer a more traditional look. When choosing, consider the overall design of your deck and the specific areas you want to illuminate to ensure functionality and ambiance.
